title: Turkish Kebabs with Guanciale Crust
description: A unique twist on traditional Turkish kebabs with the addition of crispy guanciale crust. Perfect for a quick dinner or meal prep.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together sumac, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture onto the guanciale slices.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook the guanciale until crispy.
Set the guanciale aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Place the lamb shoulder pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Thread the chopped onion, mushrooms, bell peppers, and tomato onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with the spice mixture.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
During the last 2 minutes of cooking, brush the guanciale slices onto the kebabs.
Serve the kebabs on flatbread with additional guanciale slices on top, if desired.
